name: Snowplow Source
shortDescription: Read data from Snowplow and publish it to a Kafka topic.
longDescription:
Use this connector to connect to Snowplow and publish your data to a Kafka topic .
This connector is for an AWS Kinesis backed Snowplow installation

Variables.Name: output
Variables.Description: This is the Quix Topic that will receive the stream

Variables.Name: AWS_CONNECTION
Variables.Description: AWS credentials and region from a shared Variable Group.
Variables.VariableGroupDescription: Shared AWS credentials, region and optional S3-compatible endpoint.

Variables.Description: The AWS region your resources live in
AWS session token, for temporary credentials only
Custom endpoint for S3-compatible storage such as MinIO. Leave empty for AWS

Variables.Name: aws_stream_name
Variables.Description: The name of the AWS stream you want to use
